description: Nahversorgung ÖV Haltestelle is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by inkar.de. Proportion of inhabitants with a maximum distance of 1000m to the nearest public transport stop with at least 20 departures per day in %. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Local public transport station" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Population distribution — demography, Raumbeobachtung, Verkehr. The listing shows 2026-01-07 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
